title: It's Not a Dashboard. It's a Markets Cockpit.
author: Prestigious-Bank2145

comments.author: Prestigious-Bank2145
comments.body: The platform combines **real-time global markets**, **AI-selected news**, **macro indicators**, **sentiment gauges**, **crypto, FX, commodities, bonds, volatility metrics**, and an **AI Knowledge Hub** covering topics such as AI investing, AI trading, data centers, chips, metals, energy demand, and market impacts of artificial intelligence. It feels like a command center where investors connect AI trends with market movements, not just a screen of quotes.
